offer.text: Consult a cleric as a neutral local mediator, then return here. Payment: five emeralds. This commission answers one recorded regional opportunity or signed voluntary obligation.

accept.text: This is a civilian consultation; it changes no military relation.

decline.text: No settlement is imposed without your agreement.

in_progress.text: Speak with a cleric and return to the original issuer.

ready.text: The consultation can now be acknowledged.

complete.text: Your mediation service is recorded. Five emeralds are paid.
